body: Challenge the native AgentSession/ReceiptEnvelope fidelity contract with a counterexample that could make host or external evidence satisfy a subject model turn, make a provider-native session reference replace the governed session ID, or let artifact identity imply producer/model/transport identity. The witness rejects origin mismatch, provider/model substitution, missing producer verification, external evidence without transport identity, missing compaction/strategy transitions, and non-contiguous sequences.
subject: Cross-provider challenge: AgentSession and ReceiptEnvelope fidelity boundary
